research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Reelables is researching a wireless communication tape and flexible wireless labels as printable reeled media for tracking items across asset tracking applications. Method of fabrication of low power electronic tape for tracking items and wireless label assignment identification during printing focus on ultrathin, laminated, low power tapes linked to serialization systems. Thin film wireless label with integrated temperature sensor targets temperature monitoring. Together these efforts target tracking, identification, and condition monitoring.

about_short_description.short_description: Reelables is automating supply chains and inventory management with cellular and Bluetooth smart labels.

product.name: Bluetooth Tracking Labels
product.description: Paper-thin smart labels that broadcast Bluetooth signals to track location and inventory status in real time, updating every minute.

product.name: Temperature Logging Labels
product.description: Smart labels that measure and transmit temperature data from 0 to 60°C to monitor shipment conditions and alert users to temperature fluctuations.

product.name: NB-IoT Tracking Labels
product.description: Cellular-enabled smart labels using Narrowband IoT technology to provide global, real-time location tracking without additional infrastructure.

product.name: Demo Kit
product.description: A trial package including preprinted Bluetooth labels, gateways, software access, and onboarding support to test Reelables' tracking solutions.
